simple.summary: זָחַח (zâchach) means to shove or displace First listed occurrence: Exod 28 28.

definitions.full: H2118. zachach [ זָחַח ] verb remove, displace (Arabic push, thrust away ; compare also Aramaic זוּחַ , , move, move away (intransitive)) — Niph`al Imperfect הָאֵפוֺד מֵעַל הַחשֶׁן יִזַּח וְלֹא Exod 28:28 and that the breast-piece be not displaced etc., 39:21 (both P).
